Bachelor Of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (BVSc&Ah) is a prestigious 5.5 years graduation degree which gives veterinary doctors to the society.
This channel is dedicated to share the journey of course with study lectures, life and more to help the veterinary students in studies along with insightful knowledge & learning to public keen in  exploring the Animal world .
Come join us in this adventure and extend your love&support to this channel to make  more future progesses ahead.
